metric: Queries KumoSQL rewrites with a proof from the table definition alone; each rewrite is also executed against the original on PostgreSQL 16 and returns the same rows.
correctness: 0 behaviour-changing rewrites: 3 proven, and 3/3 return the same rows when executed
usefulness: 1 of 3 rewrites at least 10% faster (Q30, 4.51x); Q35 1.01x, Q36 1.04x
performance: Median of 5 alternating runs on 1,000,000 synthetic hits rows, PostgreSQL 16; geometric-mean speedup 1.68x over the 3 rewritten queries
caveats: Synthetic data (the real 100M-row set cannot be downloaded here), so speedups show removed work, not ClickBench results.
